name: multi-email
description: Safely manage multiple Gmail and Microsoft 365 mailboxes through one local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Route Gmail and Microsoft 365 by explicit account alias.
interface.longDescription: An alias-routed plugin for searching, reading, drafting, and organizing multiple Gmail and Microsoft 365 mailboxes. Sending requires approval in a server-enforced localhost review window.
defaultPrompt: Review unread mail across my connected accounts without making changes.
Create a draft reply in a specific account for my review.
Find messages that need my reply across named account aliases.
